maria (docs): FYI CI linkcheck started failing only for the localized site builds (en-uk, fr-fr). Seeing a bunch of broken fragment errors that only appear when the path ends with a trailing slash.

docs-ci-bot: linkcheck report: "Broken link: /en-uk/getting-started/#installation/ -> 404" (10 files)

sanjay (platform): hmm, I remember MkDocs has two URL styles. are we generating directory URLs with trailing slashes? what's use_directory_urls set to?

maria (docs): it's true — mkdocs.yml has use_directory_urls: true for the localized builds. The non-localized site uses false in the CI matrix. Might explain difference.

jonah (eng): quick repro: locally with use_directory_urls: true the anchor becomes /guide/#installation/ and our anchor slug generator creates #installation (no trailing slash) so linkcheck treats those as mismatch.

diane (i18n): this only popped up after the recent migration where we added locale prefixes + redirects. Some translated pages had their headings auto-normalized differently.

maria (docs): Proposed fixes: either normalize all links in docs to drop trailing slashes in anchors, or force use_directory_urls: false in localized builds so anchors are consistent. Which is less risky?

sanjay (platform): For stability I prefer changing CI build config for localized builds first (force use_directory_urls: false) while we batch-fix content. That avoids changing output URLs in production customers rely on.

jonah (eng): I can push a small CI patch. Will add a smoke-check that runs linkcheck against a generated sitemap and fails only on truly missing pages (not anchor-format mismatches).

maria (docs): created a quick PR with docs preview changes + a content sweep for the worst offenders: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/12345. The PR also adds a lint rule to warn for inline links that end with /#fragment.

jonah (eng): pushed CI tweak in platform/ci#987 to set MKDOCS_USE_DIRECTORY_URLS=false for localized matrix. Let's see if the next build is green.

docs-ci-bot: Build #2024-12-18 for branch localized-ci-patch — linkcheck stage: STARTED

docs-ci-bot: Build #2024-12-18 — linkcheck stage: SUCCESS (0 broken links) :tada:

diane (i18n): Awesome. For follow-up I'll create a tiny script to normalize heading IDs across locales (strip trailing slashes in href fragments) and run it as an optional lint job.

maria (docs): I'll open a follow-up PR that removes the trailing slash pattern from our example snippets and SDK READMEs (noticed a few examples linking like /api/#usage/).

sanjay (platform): Thanks — can you add a short note to the docs migration guide about this quirk? People upgrading from older MkDocs themes may hit it.

maria (docs): Yep will add. Closing thread once follow-ups are in PR. :white_check_mark:

jonah (eng): quick note for the record: config option mapping i.e. use_directory_urls:true -> directory-style URLs with trailing slash on directories can change how anchors render. If you have anchor-sensitive linkcheck, normalize either output or source links.

maria (docs): thread summary: 1) CI tweak to force consistent URL style for localized builds (done); 2) content sweep and lint to catch trailing-slash fragment links (PR 12345); 3) optional heading-id normalizer for locales (diane follow-up).
